title: Claim Service Fee on Northgate Protect Accident Plans: Fee Schedule and Computation
content:
**Claim decided.** On a Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year, 3-Year or 4-Year plan, the claim decided is the latest claim filed on the plan that does not yet carry a decision, a claim being marked with its decision when the decision is recorded; where two such claims share that filing date, it is the one listed first on the plan's ledger. Its claim type, incident date and filing date are read from that claim.

**Fee.** The claim service fee is the amount of the tier's service-fee band containing the covered item price recorded on the plan when the decided claim's type is one the tier charges a fee on (on the Accident tiers, accidental damage), and nothing when it is not. A decision denying the claim carries no claim service fee.

**Assembly.** The claim service fee is settled from its starting amount, the band amount above; every amount that comes off it or is added to it applies to that starting amount; the fee is never below zero and is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Band amounts

| Covered item price recorded on the plan | Band amount |
|---|---|
| Below $500.00 | Nothing |
| $500.00 or more but below $1000.00 | $29.00 |
| $1000.00 or more | $49.00 |

## Boundaries

| Hypothetical recorded price | Claim type charged by the tier | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| $499.99 | Yes | Nothing |
| $500.00 | Yes | $29.00 |
| $999.99 | Yes | $29.00 |
| $1000.00 | Yes | $49.00 |
| $1500.00 | No (a type the tier does not charge) | Nothing |

## Worked example on hypothetical figures

Two undecided claims on a plan, filed on 3 May and on 9 May; the claim filed on 9 May is decided. It is accidental damage, and the plan records a covered item price of $760.00. The fee is $29.00. Had the plan recorded $1,240.00, the fee would be $49.00.
